                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

          Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and              
          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough            
          to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area, and           
          its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in the                
          middle of a word unless the word is wider than the line.

          Ink bottles    3    8.25

          Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long enough

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          1. Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and           
             Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long                
             enough to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text           
             area, and its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never          
             in the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the          
             line.                                                              
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          1. Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and           
             1.Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph is long              
             enough to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text           
             area, and its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never          
             in the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the          
             line.

          be.

             in the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the          
             line.

                            Quill: a plain document                             
                                                                                
          1. Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and           
             1.5         Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph            
             is long enough to wrap onto several lines in a sixty               
             column text area, and its lines break after spaces and             
             hyphens, never in the middle of a word unless the word is          
             wider than the line.                                               
                                                                                
          Name Quantity  Price                                                  
          Quills    12   3.50                                                   
          Ink bottles    3    8.25                                              
                                                                                
          A line break                                                          
          keeps the paragraph together, and a                                   
          supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-looking-word-that-has-no-          
          spaces-and-is-far-longer-than-a-line is cut where it must             
          be.                                                                   
          The end.

             is long enou

             in the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the          
             line.

             is long enou

             and its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in             
             the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the             
             line.

          1. Quill is a small word processor for DOS, Windows 3.1 and           
             1.5         Windows 95, written in Rust. This paragraph            
             is long enou                                                       
          2.                                                                    
          3.  to wrap onto several lines in a sixty column text area,           
             and its lines break after spaces and hyphens, never in             
             the middle of a word unless the word is wider than the             
             line.
